ticker_news.title: Tech Rallies Ahead Of Nvidia Earnings, Bitcoin Jumps 7%: What's Moving Markets Wednesday?
ticker_news.description: Markets rallied on Wednesday with risk appetite returning as investors positioned ahead of Nvidia's earnings report. The Nasdaq 100 climbed 1.2%, S&P 500 rose 0.7%, and Bitcoin jumped 7%. Tech and software stocks led gains, while energy and consumer staples lagged. Notable earnings movers included strong performances from Circle Internet Group, CAVA Group, and Everus Construction Group, while GoDaddy, First Solar, and CoStar Group declined.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari

ticker_news.title: Nvidia Earnings Preview: A Make-or-Break Moment for the AI Trade
ticker_news.description: Nvidia is set to report fiscal Q4 earnings on Wednesday evening, with analysts expecting strong results including $1.52 EPS (71% YoY growth) and $65.6B revenue (67% YoY growth). The Data Center segment is projected to dominate at $58.7B, driven by Blackwell chip production and hyperscaler AI spending. A beat-and-raise could reignite market confidence in the AI boom, while any miss could trigger a sharp correction. The stock is expected to move +/-6% post-earnings, with key technical levels at $194.50 (bullish) and $191.50 (bearish).
ticker_news.author: Jesse Cohen

ticker_news.title: Palantir Billionaire Peter Thiel Dumped Nvidia, Tesla, Microsoft, and Apple. What Stocks Does He Own for 2026?
ticker_news.description: Peter Thiel's hedge fund Thiel Macro liquidated its entire stock portfolio in Q4 2025, including positions in Nvidia, Tesla, Microsoft, and Apple. The move reflects concerns about AI competition, macroeconomic uncertainty, and geopolitical tensions. While Thiel rotated to cash, the article suggests long-term retail investors need not follow suit given the S&P 500's historical resilience.
ticker_news.author: Adam Spatacco

ticker_news.title: What Is One of the Best Tech Stocks to Hold for the Next Decade?
ticker_news.description: Nokia is positioned as an underestimated winner for the next decade due to its partnership with Nvidia to develop 6G wireless infrastructure powered by AI. As AI adoption strains current 5G networks, the 6G market is expected to grow at 24% annually through 2034, with Nokia well-positioned to capture significant market share.
ticker_news.author: James Brumley

ticker_news.title: This AI Stock Has Soared 123% Since Its IPO. Is It Still a Buy for 2026?
ticker_news.description: CoreWeave, an AI infrastructure company, has surged 123% since its March 2025 IPO but remains volatile. Despite a 51% decline from its 52-week high, the company's massive $56 billion revenue backlog, expanding data center capacity, and expected 4x revenue growth by 2027 position it as a strong long-term buy. With McKinsey projecting $1.7 trillion in AI data center spending by 2030, CoreWeave is well-positioned to capitalize on this secular growth opportunity.
ticker_news.author: Harsh Chauhan
